topics.title: About the Program
topics.teaser: Computer Science at Chula's Faculty of Science, offered since 2535 BE (1992)

body.text: The Bachelor of Science program in Computer Science has been offered since 2535 BE (1992) by the Department of Mathematics and Computer Science, Faculty of Science, Chulalongkorn University. The current curriculum is the 2023 (2566 BE) revision.

The program focuses on both theoretical knowledge and real-world applications, with theory and hands-on work starting in the first year, alongside critical thinking, problem-solving, and communication.
Highlights

items: Learn from professors and researchers with real-world experience
Join research projects from your first year to your final year
Collaborate with alumni and experts inside and outside the university
International projects and study exchanges with partner institutions abroad

body.text: Our Department

The department was founded on 29 January 1933 (2476 BE), starting as the Mathematics Section of the Faculty of Arts and Science, and was the first in Thailand to offer bachelor's, master's, and doctoral degrees.

topics.title: Undergraduate Program
topics.teaser: B.Sc. in Computer Science with three study programs to choose from

body.text: The program prepares graduates to apply computer science and digital technology to create innovations or integrate with other disciplines, ready for emerging technologies and advanced study.
Curriculum structure (2023 revision)
Every program includes 30 credits of general education, 12 credits of science foundations, 14 core credits, 39 specialized credits, and 6 free-elective credits (minimum totals shown).
Field experience, 8 credits

items: Option 1: Internship
Option 2: Cooperative education (not available in the Honors program)

topics.title: Career Paths
topics.teaser: Our graduates are sought after by leading tech companies and startups

body.text: Graduates have found positions at well-known technology companies and startups. Example careers include:

items: Software, web, and mobile app developer
Data scientist or analyst
Artificial intelligence or machine learning engineer
Cloud solutions architect
Network engineer
Database administrator
Systems analyst
Quality assurance engineer
IT consultant
Researcher or scientist

topics.title: Master's & Ph.D.
topics.teaser: M.Sc. and Ph.D. in Computer Science and Information Technology

body.text: The department offers the M.Sc. and Ph.D. in Computer Science and Information Technology. The Ph.D. program has run research activities since 1999, and both programs carry out research through the Advanced Virtual and Intelligent Computing (AVIC) Research Center.
Master's degree, 36 credits
The thesis option suits students seeking in-depth study who plan to continue to a doctorate. The master project option suits students who want broad knowledge for a career in the computer industry.
Doctoral degree

items: Type 1.1, for master's graduates: 48 thesis credits
Type 2.2, for bachelor's graduates: 24 coursework + 48 thesis credits, 72 in total

topics.title: Research
topics.teaser: Eight computing research areas, from AI to quantum computing

body.text: Students at every level can join research projects with faculty. The department's computer science research areas are:

items.label: Algorithms, Optimization, Parallel Computing and Theoretical Computer Science
Computer Network, Network Security and Cryptography

body.text: The department is home to faculty, researchers, graduate students, and staff. See each person's position and expertise in the department directory.

topics.title: News & Events

body.text: News and events are updated often. Follow the latest on the department website and social media.

topics.title: Admissions
topics.teaser: Undergraduates apply through TCAS; graduate admission opens twice a year

body.text: Undergraduate

Admission is through Chulalongkorn University's TCAS system. Applicants must have completed upper secondary school (Grade 12) or equivalent and meet the requirements announced by the university and the Council of University Presidents of Thailand.

items: Round 1: Portfolio
Round 2: Quota
Round 3: Admission

body.text: Master's & Ph.D.

items: First semester (Aug–Dec): applications open from February
Second semester (Jan–May): applications open from June
Master's: a bachelor's degree (or final semester in progress) with a GPA of at least 2.50, or at least one year of work experience
Ph.D.: a B.Sc. or B.Eng. with second-class honors, or a master's degree, with a GPA of at least 3.25 or a thesis graded good

body.text: English score requirements, required documents, and tuition may change. Please check the prospective students page for the latest details.
